schema.name: Knowledge Area/Skill Area Unified Schema v2

description: Software engineering is the discipline concerned with the application of theory, knowledge, and practice to effectively and efficiently build reliable software systems that satisfy the needs of customers and users.

sections.title: SE/Software Processes
sections.summary: This section covers the fundamentals of software processes, including different lifecycle models like waterfall, iterative, and agile

learning_outcomes.text: the ability to select and justify an appropriate software process for a given project.

sections.title: SE/Software Design
sections.summary: This section covers software design principles and practices

learning_outcomes.text: creating and documenting a software design for a medium-sized application.
Students will learn about concepts like coupling, cohesion, and design patterns.
